answer: Entropy floor: each grader's last 40 seals are binned by score 0 to 3. Shannon entropy under 1.0 bit, of a possible 2, flags a lazy grader, whose pay drops to half for 10 epochs. A grader always sealing 2 has 0 bits and loses 50 percent across its whole grove of seats; honest graders on real rows land near 1.5 bits. Bypass: a random sealer scores 2 bits and passes unless the jury match rate is also checked, so the pulse of agreement needs its own floor. Check rule: anyone recomputes entropy from the public ledger; a tundra of constant scores marks lazy seats.
